_comment: Per-machine config. config.json is gitignored; copy this file to config.json and adjust paths. The box (guppy) keeps its own config.json with local paths.

codegen._comment: OpenAI-compatible model that writes runnable skill bodies. Larger/slower than the decision or self-assessment model. The transport always streams so the client-side token budget (output cap / peak total fill) can abort a runaway in real time; stream only toggles console echo of tokens. timeout is total seconds; idle_warn/idle_timeout surface a silent (wedged) stream. The context window is auto-detected via ollama /api/show; context_window is the manual fallback (0 = auto/default 100000). smart_limit/warn_limit and max_fill_ratio/warn_fill_ratio bound total fill; max_output caps streamed output (>=1 absolute tokens, 0<x<1 fraction of window); chars_per_token converts chars to the token estimate. temperature/top_p/presence_penalty/frequency_penalty follow the Qwen3.8 model card's instruct-mode anti-repetition guidance (high presence_penalty, not greedy temperature); generate_skill_body escalates to presence 2.0 / temp 0.5 on retries (max_attempts attempts, fresh short prompt each time).

degeneration._comment: SemIf degeneration watchdog: while the body streams, a 2-option SemIf decision (continue/stop) is made every `interval` chars against the last `window` chars of content+reasoning (once `min_chars` have accumulated); P(stop) >= threshold aborts the write with a graceful stub. Recorded trace-only (kind `codegen`), never in the decision log. Disabled when no engine is available.
